facts.fact: The World Bank says almost 1.5 million households were receiving safety-net transfers electronically through bank accounts as of December 2022: 961,185 in the rural Productive Safety Net Programme and 411,000 in the urban programme, which has paid electronically since 2016.
facts.system: Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP) and Urban Productive Safety Net and Jobs Program (UPSNJP)

facts.fact: The World Bank says it is supporting a Government of Ethiopia pilot of electronic safety-net payments through the Telebirr mobile money service in two selected regions.
facts.system: Telebirr mobile money pilot for safety-net payments

systems.system: Urban Productive Safety Net and Jobs Program (UPSNJP)

facts.fact: The World Bank's Global Findex Database reports Ethiopia's financial inclusion at 46% as of 2022.
The National Bank of Ethiopia says adult Ethiopians with a bank account rose from 22% in 2014 to about 45% in 2020.

facts.fact: The World Bank says Ethiopia has expanded financial inclusion by promoting adoption of mobile money services, and names Telebirr as a mobile money service.
